id: 13_Fundamentals of Working Safely in a Biological Safety Cabinet (BSC) Preparing fo
title: 开工前，先把安全柜准备好
source_doc: course/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/13_Fundamentals of Working Safely in a Biological Safety Cabinet (BSC) Preparing fo.md
author_source: project/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/13_Fundamentals of Working Safely in a Biological Safety Cabinet (BSC) Preparing fo/src.py

points.K18: 湿巾擦拭，作用时间要够

shots.scene: 欣欣站在生物安全柜前，手里拿着空白核查表
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a biological safety cabinet holding a clipboard with a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 这一课讲安全柜开工前的准备。
overlay: 开工前，先把安全柜准备好

shots.scene: 核查表上的几个空白方框依次打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank checklist with empty boxes being ticked one by one with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 准备做足，操作才安心。

shots.scene: 阿杰进实验室，直接把样品放进安全柜
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks in and immediately puts a sample rack into the biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 阿杰一进门就把样品往柜里放。

shots.scene: 他做到一半，起身去拿忘带的吸头
shots.prompt_en: Halfway through, the young male student stands up and leaves the cabinet to fetch a forgotten tip box.
shots.narration: 做到一半，发现吸头没带。

shots.scene: 小研指着推车，摇摇头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points to an empty cart beside the cabinet and shakes her head.
shots.narration: 小研说：准备没做，越忙越乱。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs-up in front of a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 一步一步，跟着清单来。

shots.scene: 小研看着日历，圈出一段空白时间
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student circles a block of time on a blank calendar.
shots.narration: 先留出一段不被打断的时间。

shots.scene: 推车上摆着吸水垫、废物袋、移液器、吸头、离心管、振荡器、小锐器盒、纸巾
shots.prompt_en: A cart holding absorbent pads, a small biohazard waste bag on a stand, pipettes, tip boxes, microtubes, a vortex mixer, a small sharps container and paper towels, all with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 要用的东西，一次备齐。

shots.scene: 推车停在安全柜旁边
shots.prompt_en: The stocked cart is parked right next to the biological safety cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 放在柜旁的推车上，伸手就拿到。

shots.scene: 塑料洗瓶装消毒剂，贴着空白标签
shots.prompt_en: A plastic squeeze bottle of disinfectant with a blank label on the cart. No people.
shots.narration: 再备一瓶装在洗瓶里的消毒剂。

shots.scene: 小研在洗瓶上贴标签，王老师在旁指导
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sticks a blank label on the bottle while the safety administrator watches and nods.
shots.narration: 按规定标明名称，拿不准就问老师。

shots.scene: 小研走到安全柜前，看向控制面板
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, in a lab coat, goggles and gloves, walks to the cabinet and looks at the control panel.
shots.narration: 开柜第一步：确认紫外灯关了。

shots.scene: 面板上紫外灯开关拨到关
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a control panel switch with a lamp icon moved to the off position. No people.
shots.narration: 开着紫外灯，人不能靠近操作。

shots.scene: 柜上贴着空白检测合格标签，手指指向有效期一栏
shots.prompt_en: A gloved finger points at a blank certification tag on the cabinet, at the empty date line. No people.
shots.narration: 看一眼检测标签，是否还在有效期。

shots.scene: 三个图标：新装、搬动、日历
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a new cabinet being installed, a cabinet on a moving dolly, and a calendar. No people.
shots.narration: 新装、搬动后，和定期，都要检测。

shots.scene: 小研打开照明和风机开关
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student switches on the cabinet light and the blower fan on the control panel.
shots.narration: 打开照明灯和风机。

shots.scene: 报警开关打开，绿灯亮
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the alarm switch turned on with a green indicator light. No people.
shots.narration: 确认前窗报警开关是打开的。

shots.scene: 小研把前窗拉到柜上标记的高度
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student slides the front window up to the height mark on the cabinet frame.
shots.narration: 前窗拉到柜上标明的高度。

shots.scene: 前窗过高，红灯闪烁
shots.prompt_en: The front window is raised past the mark and a red alarm light flashes. No people.
shots.narration: 拉得太高，报警就会响。

shots.scene: 小研弯腰查看台面下的排液阀
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student bends down to check the drain valve under the cabinet work surface.
shots.narration: 低头看看台面下的排液阀。

shots.scene: 阀门手柄与阀体垂直，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a valve handle turned perpendicular to the valve body with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 手柄和阀体垂直，就是关着的。

shots.scene: 柜内空气中的小颗粒被气流带走，旁边一个计时器
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of tiny particles inside the cabinet being swept away by airflow, next to a blank timer. No people.
shots.narration: 开机后先空转一会儿，吹净颗粒。

shots.scene: 柜顶的压差表，指针在中间
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a round pressure gauge on top of the cabinet with a blank dial and the needle in the middle. No people.
shots.narration: 柜上有压差表的，要读数。

shots.scene: 小研在柜上的空白记录表上填写
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes on a blank log sheet taped to the cabinet.
shots.narration: 读完记下来，和上次比一比。

shots.scene: 两条曲线：缓慢上升的打勾，突然跳变的警示
shots.prompt_en: Two line icons: a slowly rising line with a green check, and a sudden jump with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 慢慢变，是滤网积尘；突变要警惕。

shots.scene: 过滤器上的堵塞和破口图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a clogged filter and a torn filter, each with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 可能是过滤系统堵了或者破了。

shots.scene: 压差表指针落在零位，红色警示
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the pressure gauge needle resting at zero with a red warning frame. No people.
shots.narration: 最要紧的一条：读数不能是零。

shots.scene: 小研关好前窗，打电话报告
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lowers the front window and calls on the lab phone.
shots.narration: 是零就别用，马上报告管理部门。

shots.scene: 柜上贴着记录表，每天一行
shots.prompt_en: A blank log sheet taped on the cabinet with one empty row per day and a pen on a string. No people.
shots.narration: 把记录表贴在柜上，每天记一笔。

shots.scene: 小研对比前一天的记录
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student runs her finger down the log sheet comparing today with yesterday.
shots.narration: 和前一天一比，变化一目了然。

shots.scene: 小研在前窗下沿贴一条细纸巾
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student tapes a thin strip of tissue to the bottom edge of the front window.
shots.narration: 用前，确认空气是往里吸的。

shots.scene: 纸巾条向柜内飘
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the tissue strip bends and flutters inward into the cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 纸条往里飘，说明气流正常。

shots.scene: 烟雾也被吸进开口
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a thin white smoke stream at the opening is drawn into the cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 也可以用发烟器来看。

shots.scene: 小研把洗瓶和一叠纸巾放进柜内
shots.prompt_en: After the cabinet has run for a while, the female graduate student places the disinfectant bottle and paper towels inside.
shots.narration: 空转够时间，把消毒用品放进柜里。

shots.scene: 洗瓶旁边有一本空白规程，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: The disinfectant squeeze bottle next to a blank procedure document with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 消毒剂要用规程里指定的那种，

shots.scene: 消毒剂图标对准病原图标
shots.prompt_en: A disinfectant bottle icon with an arrow hitting a microbe icon that fades away. No people.
shots.narration: 对你操作的病原确实有效。

shots.scene: 小研用纸巾擦侧壁
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes the side wall of the cabinet with a towel wetted with disinfectant.
shots.narration: 用浸湿的纸巾擦侧壁，

shots.scene: 擦后壁和前窗玻璃内侧
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes the back wall, then the inside of the front window glass.
shots.narration: 再擦后壁和前窗玻璃内侧，

shots.scene: 擦台面
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a gloved hand wipes the work surface from back to front. No people.
shots.narration: 最后擦台面。

shots.scene: 在柜内喷洒消毒剂的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a spray bottle misting inside a cabinet, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要在柜里喷消毒剂。

shots.scene: 雾滴被吸进格栅和过滤器
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of fine mist drawn into the grille and up toward the filter, with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 雾滴会被吸进格栅和过滤器，

shots.scene: 不锈钢表面出现小坑，过滤器出现破损
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a stainless steel surface with small pits and a damaged filter. No people.
shots.narration: 腐蚀柜体，损坏过滤器。

shots.section_title: 湿巾擦拭，作用时间要够
shots.scene: 小研把纸巾充分润湿
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student squeezes plenty of disinfectant onto a folded paper towel.
shots.narration: 把纸巾充分润湿，再去擦。
overlay: 湿巾擦拭，作用时间要够

shots.section_title: 湿巾擦拭，作用时间要够
shots.scene: 擦过的表面保持湿润，旁边一个沙漏
shots.prompt_en: A wiped surface still visibly wet next to an hourglass icon. No people.
shots.narration: 让消毒剂停留够时间。

shots.section_title: 湿巾擦拭，作用时间要够
shots.scene: 用过的纸巾丢进柜内的感染性废物袋
shots.prompt_en: A used towel goes into a small bag with a biohazard warning sign standing inside the cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 用过的纸巾，丢进感染性废物袋。

shots.scene: 把头伸进柜内的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person leaning their head inside a cabinet opening, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 无论如何，头不要伸进安全柜。

shots.scene: 小研用伸缩拖把擦后壁
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, standing upright, wipes the far back wall with an extendable mop.
shots.narration: 够不着后壁，用伸缩拖把。

shots.scene: 拖布丢进感染性废物袋
shots.prompt_en: The used disposable mop pad is dropped into the biohazard waste bag. No people.
shots.narration: 一次性拖布，用完丢进废物袋。

shots.scene: 空白标签的漂白剂瓶和清水瓶
shots.prompt_en: A bottle of bleach and a bottle of water, both with blank labels, side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 用的是漂白类消毒剂？

shots.scene: 小研用清水再擦一遍
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes the surfaces again with a towel wetted with water.
shots.narration: 再用清水或乙醇擦一遍，去掉残留。

shots.scene: 不锈钢上的小坑里藏着微生物
shots.prompt_en: A magnified diagram of a pit in stainless steel with microbe icons hiding inside. No people.
shots.narration: 残留会腐蚀出小坑，藏住微生物。

shots.scene: 小研摘下手套丢进废物袋，换上新手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student removes her gloves into the biohazard bag, then puts on a fresh pair at the cart.
shots.narration: 消毒做完，摘手套、换新手套。

shots.scene: 小研坐在柜前调座椅高度
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sits in front of the cabinet and adjusts the height of her chair.
shots.narration: 坐下前，先调好座椅高度。

shots.scene: 侧面示意：脸高于前窗开口，腋窝与前窗下沿齐平
shots.prompt_en: A side-view diagram of a seated person: the face above the window opening and the armpits level with the bottom of the window. No people.
shots.narration: 脸在开口上方，腋窝和前窗下沿齐平。

shots.scene: 小研在空白核查表上逐项打勾
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student ticks boxes on a blank checklist in a binder beside the cabinet.
shots.narration: 用核查表逐项打勾，一项不落。

shots.scene: 王老师举起空白操作规程
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds up a blank standard operating procedure document.
shots.narration: 具体要求，以本实验室规程为准。

shots.scene: 上锁的安全柜旁挂着空白授权牌
shots.prompt_en: A biological safety cabinet with a blank authorization tag hanging on it and a small lock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 安全柜不是谁都能直接上手。

shots.scene: 王老师给阿杰发空白培训证书
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands the young male student a blank training certificate.
shots.narration: 先培训、考核，获得授权再使用。

shots.scene: 空白风险评估表和实验室门牌
shots.prompt_en: A blank risk assessment form next to a lab door plate with a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 做病原实验，先评估，在相应级别实验室做。

shots.scene: 小研戴手套护目镜，在通风处配消毒液
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing gloves, goggles and a lab coat, dilutes a disinfectant into a labeled bottle at a ventilated bench.
shots.narration: 配消毒液，戴好手套和护目镜。

shots.scene: 含氯消毒剂瓶和酸性清洁剂瓶靠在一起，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A chlorine disinfectant bottle and an acid cleaner bottle pushed together, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 含氯消毒剂，不与酸性物品混用。

shots.scene: 新配的消毒液瓶贴空白标签，旁边日历
shots.prompt_en: A freshly made disinfectant bottle with a blank label and a small calendar icon. No people.
shots.narration: 现配现用，标明名称和配制日期。

shots.scene: 紫外灯亮着，人员离开房间的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a cabinet with a glowing lamp and a person icon walking out of the room door. No people.
shots.narration: 紫外灯开着时，人要离开，不能直视。

shots.scene: 紫外线照不到的角落和物品阴影
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of lamp rays inside a cabinet; shadows behind boxes and in corners stay unlit. No people.
shots.narration: 照不到阴影和角落，替代不了擦拭。

shots.scene: 老李检查灯管，记录在空白表上
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks the cabinet lamp tube and writes on a blank maintenance log.
shots.narration: 灯管会老化，要定期检测更换。

shots.scene: 柜内吸水垫上洒了一小滩液体
shots.prompt_en: A small liquid spill on an absorbent pad on the cabinet work surface, with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 柜里洒了一点样品，别慌。

shots.scene: 小研让风机继续运行，用纸巾盖住溢洒处
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student keeps the cabinet running and covers the spill with paper towels.
shots.narration: 风机别关，用纸巾盖住溢洒处。

shots.scene: 消毒剂从外向内倒在纸巾上，沙漏
shots.prompt_en: Disinfectant is poured onto the towels from the edges toward the center, next to an hourglass icon. No people.
shots.narration: 从外向里浇消毒剂，作用够时间。

shots.scene: 纸巾进感染性废物袋，台面再擦一遍
shots.prompt_en: The soaked towels go into the biohazard bag and the surface is wiped again. No people.
shots.narration: 清理入袋，再把柜内擦一遍。

shots.scene: 小研向老周报告
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports to the older man, who notes it on a blank form.
shots.narration: 事后报告负责人，登记经过。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现推车、检测标签、压差表图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a stocked cart, a certification tag and a pressure gauge.
shots.narration: 备齐物品，查标签、看压差。

shots.scene: 紫外灯关、报警开、前窗到位、阀门关四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons with green checks: lamp off, alarm on, window at mark, drain valve closed. No people.
shots.narration: 灯关、报警开、窗到位、阀关好。

shots.scene: 纸条内飘、湿巾擦拭、喷壶打叉三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons: a tissue strip blowing inward, a wet towel wiping, and a spray bottle crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 确认吸气，湿巾擦拭，不喷不伸头。

shots.scene: 座椅、核查表、授权牌三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an adjustable chair, a blank checklist and a blank authorization tag. No people.
shots.narration: 坐姿调好，清单打勾，持证上岗。

shots.scene: 欣欣坐在安全柜前，向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot sits at a clean biological safety cabinet with the window at the mark and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 准备到位，安心开工，下次见！
